DELAY.HINT: Time in milliseconds to wait before beginning this animation
DELAY.LABEL: Delay

LOOPCOUNT.HINT: Number of times in a row to play this animation.
LOOPCOUNT.LABEL: Loop Count

IMMEDIATE.HINT: If enabled, will not wait for the current animation to finish when playing this sequence.
IMMEDIATE.LABEL: Immediate

RESETANIMATION.HINT: The animation to play after this sequence finishes, if any.
RESETANIMATION.LABEL: Reset Animation
